author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am prepared to retire the manual hand over for acceptance criteria if the evaluation process is rigorous enough to catch drift before it hits the shelf. Right now, I accept the slow, tedious work of documenting every test case by hand because I need to be certain no broken logic slips into the morning order window. If we automate the harness, I will give up that manual checkpoint, but only if the automated checks are strict enough to flag a heatwave induced demand shift without a human reviewing the output first. I am trading my time for speed, but I will not trade accuracy for convenience. The model must prove it handles the weather feed correctly before I let go of the pen.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the manual checkpoint and their time in exchange for speed, provided the automated system maintains strict accuracy standards.
